Over De Klant

De Justitiële Informatiedienst (Justid) is, als agentschap, een onderdeel van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid. Vingerafdrukken, informatie over de gezinssituatie, een strafverleden of de geldigheid van een verblijfsvergunning, detentie-informatie voor slachtoffers en burgemeesters, wanneer een dader weer vrijkomt. Enkele voorbeelden van informatie die wij, via onze ICT-voorzieningen, beschikbaar stellen. Informatie die strikt vertrouwelijk is en met veel zorg moet worden behandeld: het gaat namelijk over mensen. En dat is ons werk; zorgen dat de juiste informatie beschikbaar is over een persoon. Wij maken dit mogelijk door slim gebruik te maken van bestaande technologie en door innovaties en creativiteit te stimuleren.

Op de locaties, Almelo, Zutphen, Den Haag en Leeuwarden werken wij met zo'n 500 professionals iedere dag keihard om onze samenleving net een beetje veiliger te maken.

ICT richt zich met name op de directies Dienstverlening en Ketenvoorzieningen. Binnen de Justitiële Informatiedienst wordt het informatievoorzieningslandschap onderhouden in productgroepen. Een productgroep onderhoudt en ontwikkelt meerdere diensten. De productgroepen zijn georganiseerd in teams. De teams passen een agile werkwijze toe, dit doen ze middels de Scrum of Kanban methode. Binnen de teams wordt gestreefd naar T-shaped werken, waarbij DevOps-engineers de specialisatie ontwikkelaar, tester, technisch (applicatie)beheerder of functioneel beheerder hebben. Daarnaast werken er binnen de productgroep product-owners, informatieanalisten en productspecialisten samen met de teams.

De informatievoorziening wordt onder architectuur ontwikkeld en onderhouden. De technische realisatie architectuur is leidend voor keuzes die gemaakt worden. In de werkgroep voor de technische realisatie architectuur worden nieuwe technieken en tools besproken. De Justitiële Informatiedienst kiest ervoor alleen veelgebruikte (mainstream) frameworks en technologieën te gebruiken. Gebruikte frameworks, tools en technologieën zijn o.a. Angular, Spring, Django, Flask, Oracle database, Robot Framework, Pytest, Jest, SonarQube, Nexus IQ, Rancher en Jenkins.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities

Develop and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, working from solution designs and contributing to implementation decisions.
Build solutions on cloud platforms, using AI services alongside application, data and cloud infrastructure components, and work effectively across the technology stacks a client environment requires.
Develop working prototypes to test technical approaches, validate requirements and support the transition to production-ready solutions.
Implement retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, including data ingestion, document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search and context assembly.
Build tool-calling and agent-based workflows, including integrations with enterprise systems, workflow state management and appropriate human approval steps.
Develop and maintain APIs, backend services and integrations that connect AI capabilities with business applications and data sources.
Experiment with models, prompts, retrieval strategies and implementation approaches to improve output quality, latency and cost.
Implement automated tests and AI evaluations covering response quality, grounding, safety, task completion and application performance.
Apply security, privacy and responsible AI requirements, including access controls, sensitive-data handling and safeguards against prompt injection and inappropriate tool access.
Contribute to automated deployment pipelines, configuration management and versioning of code, prompts and evaluation assets.
Implement logging, monitoring, error handling and operational controls; investigate issues and improve solution reliability in production.
Participate in code reviews, maintain technical documentation and collaborate with architects and other engineers to establish reusable components and development practices.
Work with business and client stakeholders to clarify requirements, demonstrate progress and communicate implementation constraints and technical issues.

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office 

Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

We hire for capability, breadth, judgement, adaptability and the ability to learn. Education, previous experience and technologies are evidence of those qualities, not a checklist. During the recruitment process, we assess the level at which you demonstrate these capabilities, including your scope, autonomy, judgement, accountability and client responsibility.

Degree educated or equivalent professional experience. Capability may be demonstrated through professional experience, formal education, independent learning or delivered work.
Hands-on experience developing and delivering software and AI applications, in software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning engineering or a comparable technical field.
Software engineering and programming experience (for example in Python), including writing modular, maintainable and tested code, and the ability to work effectively across languages, frameworks and unfamiliar technology stacks.
An understanding of how AI solutions fit into wider software and enterprise systems, including software architecture, APIs and integration, data, infrastructure, identity and access, security, deployment, observability and production operations.
Experience developing solutions on cloud platforms, including AI services and supporting application, data and identity components.

Experience implementing tool calling or agent workflows, including integration with external APIs and business systems.
Experience building APIs and backend services, processing data and integrating applications with structured and unstructured data sources.
Experience contributing to solutions beyond proof of concept, including testing, deployment, monitoring and production support.
Experience with AI evaluation techniques, including test datasets, quality metrics and regression testing for changes to models, prompts and retrieval pipelines.
An understanding of software engineering practices, including version control, code reviews, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
An understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, secrets management and data protection.
The ability to diagnose problems across system boundaries and to make and explain implementation trade-offs across quality, performance, reliability and cost.
Collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain implementation choices to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are a self-directed learner: you identify gaps in your knowledge, learn unfamiliar concepts and technologies independently, and become effective in new technical domains. Curiosity and adaptability matter more than familiarity with a particular stack.

Additional experience that would be valuable:

Experience with AI and cloud services across more than one cloud provider.
Knowledge of traditional machine learning, data science and model lifecycle management.
Experience with infrastructure as code, containerized deployments and cloud application operations.
Experience with frameworks and libraries for retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration or AI evaluation.
Experience delivering solutions for public-sector or regulated-industry clients.

Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
You’ll receive a contract for 32-40 hours.
A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
29 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.

The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.

Ready to shape your future with us? About your application process

For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV and examples of your work. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.
Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within 5 days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.
First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.
Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.
We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

Paid to build what you'd build anyway — real compensation for real development work on your own project

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Java / SAP Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team. In an environment where our SDLC is powered by cutting-edge AI tools (including generative AI for coding, testing, and documentation), your primary focus will shift from boilerplate implementation to high-level system architecture, critical evaluation of AI-generated code, and complex problem-solving across both Java cloud platforms and SAP ERP environments.

This role is for a developer who sees AI not as a replacement for skill, but as a force multiplier that demands greater judgment, technical depth, and prompt engineering expertise. Leveraging AI, you will work across the entire software development Lifecycle to enable connectivity into SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems—collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality, impactful solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Enhanced Development & SAP Connectivity: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable Java microservices (primarily using Spring Boot/Spring Framework). Utilize AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, internal tools) to increase speed and offload repetitive tasks.
Critical AI Code Review & Optimization: Serve as the final technical authority on all AI-generated code. Rigorously review, debug, and optimize suggested code for performance, security, and adherence to SAP Clean Core standards and enterprise design patterns.
System Architecture & Hybrid SAP Connectivity: Lead the design and implementation of distributed connectivity components across hybrid SAP ECC and S/4HANA estates, ensuring resilience, low latency, and clean data structures.
Prompt Engineering for SDLC: Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques to maximize the efficacy of generative AI tools for writing comprehensive unit/integration tests, drafting technical documentation (Javadoc, API specs), and generating code refactoring suggestions.
CI/CD and Observability: Oversee and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (CI/CD, Kubernetes/Docker) in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure/GCP), leveraging AI tools for proactive anomaly detection and monitoring.

Required Technical Qualifications

5+ years of professional experience in developing enterprise-level applications using Java (8+ / modern Java).
Proficiency with the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security).
Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD), software design patterns, and Microservices architecture.
SAP Connectivity & Clean Core Architecture: Proven experience building with SAP Clean Core principles across both SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments.
SAP Basis & Technical Integration Literacy: Familiarity with SAP Basis administration concepts, system architecture, RFC connections, secure gateways, and system integration troubleshooting.
Strong practical experience with concurrency and multithreading in Java to build highly performant services.
Proficiency in modern DevOps practices, including Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Solid understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., ReactJS, MobX).
Experience with relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis).

Essential AI-Era Skills (The "New Bar")

AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated ability to proficiently use AI-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer) in a production environment.
Code Judgment: Proven track record of evaluating and overriding AI-generated suggestions that are technically correct but architecturally flawed or non-compliant with security and performance best practices.
Prompting Proficiency: Experience writing clear, contextual, and effective prompts for generative AI to produce usable code, tests, or documentation.
Adaptability & Learning: High degree of curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new AI tools and techniques that continuously reshape the development workflow.
Domain & Architectural Focus: The capacity to abstract away from low-level coding details to focus on high-value business logic and systemic architectural integrity.
Cloud-First Mentality (AWS): A strong bias towards cloud-first development, with specific expertise in architecture and deployment on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Experience in the automation or SaaS industry.
Contributions to open-source projects or a strong GitHub portfolio.
